title: Moments of Impermanence
meta: Output: 4K/HD digital video (MP4/MOV), seamless loop; USB, digital download, or NFT
statement:
This work is a study of impermanence. Millions of dots gather, thin out, and scatter in continuous change. No shape settles; direction, density, and color keep shifting—turquoise to aquamarine to gold to violet—like breath. The image isn’t a fixed scene but a transition made visible: each formation appears only long enough to become something else. Calm, hypnotic, and never repeating, the piece turns change itself into the subject. Nothing stays; everything moves. That is the form.

Soundtrack: “Budham Sharanam Gaccami (Instrumental version)” — Yotam Agam (Infinity Lab) — Licensed via Artlist.io
